text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

words.gloss_range: conjunction opening a continued speech beat; linkage and launch are both locally possible
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as a speech-link: it carries the previous response forward while launching a fresh rhetorical beat. The payoff is continuity, so the reader hears 5:84 as continued direct speech rather than a detached maxim.

topics.headline: continued speech launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as continued direct speech rather than as a detached new statement.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction can coordinate or resume, and the boundary rows make the direct-speech continuation the local payoff.

words.gloss_range: interrogative particle in the rhetorical nominal frame, not the later relative pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the interrogative member of the repeated surface pair. Here it forms the rhetorical “what is with us” opening, pressing commitment rather than seeking information, while the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) will become the relative content believed. Its compact a-vowel cadence also delays the heavier belief verb.

topics.headline: rhetorical self-question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question form presses an affirmed commitment rather than asking for missing information.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as interrogative and subject of the nominal clause; the CRITICAL rows coherently read the formula as rhetorical.

topics.headline: question versus relative ma
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface form later returns with a different function, separating the question from the received content.
topics.reason: QAC distinguishes word 2 as interrogative and word 9 as relative, supporting the CRITICAL contrast.

topics.headline: compact a-cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening particles as a compact cadence before the heavier belief verb arrives.
topics.reason: The phonetic row gives a modest but concrete sound payoff in the opening formula.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus first-person plural suffix; dative self-concern in the rhetorical question
words.prose: {{ar:لَنَا}} ({{tr:lanā}}) turns the question inward. The preposition-plus-suffix makes the issue a matter for the speakers themselves, and the same plural “us” carries the recognized group across the boundary from 5:83.

topics.headline: speaker group carried forward

topics.reason: The attached suffix is morphologically present and boundary rows tie it to the prior speaker group.

words.gloss_range: negative particle before the imperfect; negation is folded into a rhetorical affirmation frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) places non-belief inside the question as the state under examination. Because the frame is rhetorical, the negation is not neutral denial; it makes “not believing” sound impossible for these speakers after what has come to them. The run of light particles before the main verb tightens that opening question.

topics.headline: negation inside affirmation

topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the imperfect, while the larger rhetorical frame reverses that denial into affirmation.

topics.reason: The echo row adds a concrete sound-and-sequence payoff without changing the local grammar.

words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and belief remain in the root range, while the local Form IV verb selects active believing/trusting
words.prose: {{ar:نُؤْمِنُ}} ({{tr:nuʾminu}}) gives the first main stance as ongoing first-person plural belief. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field adds trust and security pressure, but local Form IV grammar keeps the active sense as believing or trusting in the governed objects: God and what came from the truth. It also turns the 5:83 belief declaration into a question-shaped commitment, sets the ayah’s beginning-middle-end line of belief, truth, and righteousness, and its internal hamza gives the first main verb an audible catch.

The entry image is narrowed by the following with-the-people phrase into communal inclusion rather than entry into a place, and the attached “us” remains the patient of that divine action. This concentrates agency in their Lord, joins Surah 5’s entry arc from promised or resisted entry to desired admission (5:12; 5:22-24), carries the petitioning group toward the answer in 5:85, and the verb’s stops sound before the Lord-title supplies the agent.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbunā}}) supplies the explicit subject after the admission verb. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥīna}}) seals the ayah by defining the desired company. As a definite plural active participle, it presents righteousness as an ongoing communal quality, with the {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) field of soundness, fitness, wholeness, repair, and resistance to corruption gathered into the final class-title. The word reunites the belief-and-righteousness pairing across the ayah, links the hoped company with righteous figures and righteous-deeds language (3:39; 5:9; 5:69), closes on a plural community sound, and prepares the doers-of-good reward class in 5:85.

topics.headline: definite righteous class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word defining the desired people as the known righteous class.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark the word as a definite plural active participle adjective modifying al-qawm.

topics.headline: active ongoing soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteousness as an active ongoing quality, not merely a past achievement.
topics.reason: The active participle form supports ongoing quality in the final adjective.

topics.headline: sound, fit, and whole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices righteousness as soundness, fitness, wholeness, and resistance to corruption, while local syntax keeps it as the people’s defining adjective.
topics.reason: The broad ṣ-l-ḥ field is valid, but the local active participle adjective narrows it to the quality of the community.

topics.headline: belief and righteousness reunited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the common belief-and-righteousness pairing redistributed across the ayah: belief near the beginning and righteous identity at the end.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local opening belief verb and final ṣāliḥīn word into a structural dyad.

topics.headline: righteous company echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the requested company linked with established righteous figures and Surah 5 righteous-deeds language, including 3:39, 5:9, and 5:69.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references and the local final class-title supports the echo.

topics.headline: plural closing sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on a plural ending, so the aspiration lands on a community rather than one figure.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is tied to the final masculine plural surface.

topics.headline: righteous closure answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the righteous-company closure in 5:84 preparing the rewarded doers-of-good class in 5:85.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete forward uptake from final righteous company to the next ayah’s rewarded class.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نُؤْمِنُ / جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ / نَطْمَعُ / يُدْخِلَنَا ... مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth reaches the speakers as a stable reality, settles into assent, and draws hope toward Lord-caused entry into a sound human collective. The focus moves from reception through inward trust to social belonging.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the speakers' receptive commitment.
Ordinary coming supplies the incoming motion by which truth reaches them.
Reality fixed against falsehood makes the received content a stable criterion.
The heart's hope supplies the forward pull from assent toward inclusion.
Passage into an interior makes inclusion a real boundary crossing caused by the Lord.
A human collective supplies the social body into which entry is desired.
Soundness against corruption characterizes the desired collective.

changed_reading.before: A declaration of belief followed by a hope for reward.
changed_reading.after: A causal trajectory in which received truth becomes settled assent and then a petition for divinely effected membership among people marked by soundness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْحَقِّ / نُؤْمِنُ / نَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers act as subjects of believing but not as agents of admission. Certainty about truth coexists with hopeful dependence on the sovereign Lord for belonging, so epistemic confidence does not become self-certification.

activation_trace.role: Fixed reality supports confidence about what has been received.
Settled assent is an action the speakers can presently own.
Hope keeps the desired admission from being stated as a possessed entitlement.
Causative entry places the decisive transition in another agent's power.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the agent authorized to grant admission.
The collective remains a body one must be placed with rather than merely claim.

changed_reading.before: Belief and salvation are one continuous assertion of certainty.
changed_reading.after: The verse preserves an asymmetry: the speakers confidently assent to truth while humbly leaving communal and salvific admission to their Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus reverses the transit pattern of 5:61. There, claimants come, say they believe, enter carrying veiled truth, and leave unchanged; here, truth comes to the speakers, they genuinely assent, and they ask the Lord to cause a new entry among the sound.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary arrival starts the counterfeit sequence with the claimants as the moving subject.
Settled assent is the inward reality their spoken faith claim purports to have.
Inward corruption makes their entry capable of carrying concealed unbelief.
Veiling the truth names the cargo that survives their passage.
Movement outward completes a transit that produced no inward change.
The moving subject is now truth itself, which arrives at receptive speakers.
Heart-settling assent supplies the genuine inward change missing from 5:61.
Lord-caused entry redirects movement toward a sound collective rather than through concealed unbelief.

structural_cues: 5:61 orders coming, a faith claim, entry with unbelief, and exit while retaining it.
5:84 orders belief, truth's arrival, and hoped-for Lord-caused entry.
The repeated roots change both the moving subject and what is carried inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored coming, believing, and entering vocabulary plus opposed inward contents; I infer a deliberate reversal of permeability and agency. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between sincere and insincere groups without a designed lexical mirror.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely state that their belief is sincere.
changed_reading.after: Their confession enacts the inverse of counterfeit faith: truth penetrates them, changes assent, and redirects entry toward a sound communal interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hope in 5:84 occupies an announced faith-to-admission pattern. Verse 5:65 states the conditional admission of believing People of the Book into gardens, 5:69 joins belief to sound action, and 5:85 immediately returns the speakers' response to them as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the antecedent of the earlier conditional promise.
Causative passage inside supplies the promised consequence later hoped for in the focus.
A garden enclosed by vegetation gives the promised admission a concrete destination.
Suitability and fitness connect belief to action that fits its proper purpose.
Heart-hope voices the conditional promise from the position of new claimants.
The focus repeats the promised boundary crossing as a petition.
Recompense returning to its actor turns the preceding confession into consequential response.
Action met by its corresponding return closes the conditional pattern.
Doing what is good identifies the rewarded class without equating its label mechanically with صالحين.

structural_cues: 5:65 uses a counterfactual faith clause followed by divine causative admission into gardens.
5:69 links belief with صالح action, while 5:84 turns صالح into desired company.
5:85 follows the focus with reward explicitly tied to what the speakers said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated faith and admission roots, the صالح bridge, and immediate reward; I infer that 5:84 self-locates inside the earlier conditional and 5:85 narratively closes it. A live alternative is that 5:65 addresses a distinct hypothetical group and 5:85 supplies only a general afterlife outcome.

changed_reading.before: Their admission is a free-floating and uncertain wish.
changed_reading.after: Their hope is informed by an earlier conditional promise and is immediately narrated as receiving its corresponding return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus compresses a repaired reception system. Desire had filtered unwelcome arrival, and repeated blindness and deafness had sealed perception; in 5:83 hearing becomes understanding, recognition discriminates truth, affect overflows, and assent settles.

activation_trace.role: The soul's inclination supplies the earlier filter that rejects what does not suit desire.
Blindness of inward perception supplies repeated failure to recognize meaning.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply repeated closure to received speech.
Hearing as understanding and compliance reopens reception at its first stage.
Expansion from fullness makes tears the outward excess of an inwardly saturated response.
Recognition by a distinguishing sign supplies the cognitive discrimination of truth.
Reality fixed against falsehood is what reopened perception recognizes.
Settled assent is the articulated result of hearing, affect, and recognition.
Arrival anchors this sensory-cognitive sequence in what has reached the focus speakers.
Stable truth is the focus object recognized through the reopened channel.
Heart-settling assent names the focus outcome of repaired reception.

structural_cues: 5:70 opposes incoming revelation to what souls desire.
5:71 repeats the paired sequence of blindness and deafness twice.
5:83 sequences hearing, visible overflow, recognition of truth, and confession of belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closure, reopened senses, recognition, tears, and assent; I infer a functional reception pipeline rather than treating each as an isolated motif. A live alternative is that tears attest emotion only and that the sensory contrast is rhetorical rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: What came to them is simply information they accepted.
changed_reading.after: The phrase names the endpoint of restored permeability: revelation is heard, affectively registered, recognized as truth, and only then confessed as settled belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent requests form a two-stage identity transition: first place the speakers' names in the witness register, then have the Lord bring them into lived company with a fitting collective. Public attestation and actual incorporation are related but not collapsed.

activation_trace.role: Entering a name in a register or class supplies formal recognition of identity.
Presence with direct witnessing defines the class into whose record they first ask to be placed.
Actual passage inside advances beyond recorded classification to incorporation.
Sovereign lordship authorizes the transition that a register alone cannot effect.
A concrete human collective supplies the social destination of incorporation.
Fitness and suitability define the qualifying character of that destination.

structural_cues: 5:83 and 5:84 are adjacent first-person plural petitions.
Both petitions use a placement verb followed by مَعَ and a qualified human class.
The agent shifts from requested inscription to Lord-caused entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent register and entry images plus parallel with-constructions; I infer sequential public recognition and incorporation. A live alternative is that the two petitions are synonymous descriptions of one eschatological acceptance.

changed_reading.before: Admission means private reward or simple co-location with good people.
changed_reading.after: Admission completes an identity transfer that begins with public enrollment among witnesses and culminates in Lord-authorized incorporation among the fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated corrupt patronage is replaced by a different geometry of relation. Mocking allies and unbelieving loyalties give way to nearness, affection, and absence of dominance, after which the speakers seek durable company with a relation-repairing people.

activation_trace.role: Mockery supplies the degrading relation practiced by prohibited allies.
Purposeless play supplies the allies' refusal of serious shared commitment.
Love, support, and alliance define the social bond whose misuse begins the pericope.
The same alliance image is made incompatible with genuine belief near the focus.
Nearness against distance supplies the new relational geometry.
Affection supplies the positive bond that replaces hostile or mocking patronage.
Overbearing contest and domination clarify what the negated arrogance removes from the new bond.
A human collective gives the reordered relation a durable social body.
Removal of estrangement makes the desired people a relation-repairing community.

structural_cues: 5:57 forbids taking as allies those who turn religion into mockery and play.
5:80-81 again connect unbelief with misdirected alliance.
5:82 pivots from strongest hostility to nearest affection immediately before the focus request to be with another group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained sequence of alliance, proximity, affection, and non-dominance; I infer that مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ marks a transfer of affiliation. A live alternative is that مع refers only to future co-location and does not revise present social loyalties.

changed_reading.before: The speakers hope simply to join morally good people.
changed_reading.after: They seek a Lord-authorized transfer from degrading patronage structures into a near, affectionate, and relation-repairing communal bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 5:77 turns truth and people into a navigation problem: following desire-led people produces repeated straying from a level path. In the focus, received truth becomes the reference line and the صالح people become an embodied alignment with it.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the criterion religion must not exceed.
Following behind supplies the directional dependence by which a group sets one's course.
Inclination of the self supplies the unstable guide opposed to truth.
A human collective carries and propagates the desire-led trajectory.
Repeated loss of guidance supplies the result of following the wrong collective.
Straightness and completed balance supply the path's reference geometry.
An extended traversable road makes alignment a continuing course rather than one decision.
The arrived truth supplies the stable reference the speakers now accept.
Uprightness, balance, and straight standing turn the desired people into an embodied path alignment.
Fitness for purpose makes that collective congruent with the truth-reference.

structural_cues: 5:77 places truth, following, desire, a people, repeated straying, and the level path in one sequence.
5:84 repeats truth and a people but changes the desired relation from following desire to being placed with the fit.
The focus collective can therefore function as a lived orientation, not merely a demographic label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, following, desire, straying, truth, and upright or fitting group images; I infer that communal belonging embodies epistemic alignment. A live alternative is that the path language and the focus's social request remain separate moral descriptions.

changed_reading.before: Truth is a proposition and the صالح people are an unrelated reward-company.
changed_reading.after: Truth is also an orienting measure, while company with the صالح people is the social form of staying aligned to that measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material joint, interpenetration, and support branches in an ordinary moral-social sentence. It remains anchored in ٱلْحَقِّ, يُدْخِلَنَا, ٱلْقَوْمِ, and ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ, whose packet branches jointly support a fit-assembly analogy. Downstream prose should present it only as a structural analogy, not as a lexical translation or claim that the people are literally machine parts.

activation_trace.role: A right that matches its joint or receptacle supplies precise structural correspondence.
Interpenetrating parts supply the image of incorporation into an articulated whole.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative work that makes a part ready to fit.
Support and sustaining structure make the collective a load-bearing body.
Suitability for a thing supplies the exact fit by which incorporation becomes functional.

changed_reading.before: Admission places an unchanged individual beside morally good people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, lordly formation makes the speakers fitting parts of a coherent, load-bearing social body rather than merely adjacent occupants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recruits remote water branches of coming, entry, and lordly imagery. It remains worth carrying because the focus supplies arrival and admission while 5:83 supplies overflow and a filled tear-vessel and 5:85 supplies running rivers. Downstream prose should qualify it as a hydraulic analogy of receptivity and circulation, never as a claim that truth is literally water or that these focus verbs bear water senses here.

activation_trace.role: Water collecting in a depression supplies an exploratory image for truth arriving and gathering in receptive subjects.
Bringing thirsty animals back into watering supplies an exploratory image of admission into replenishing flow.
Layered rain-cloud imagery gives the nurturing Lord a remote provision role in the analogy.
Easy abundant overflow makes inward recognition visibly exceed its container.
A vessel filled until it spills gives tears the role of saturation evidence.
Continuous flowing extends reception into sustained circulation at the promised destination.
A river cutting a course through land gives the final flow a durable channel.

changed_reading.before: Truth is accepted cognitively and admission is a static placement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, received truth fills receptive persons until response overflows, and admission places them within a sustained current of provision.

strongest_changes: The 5:61 mirror turns the focus into a reversal of counterfeit transit: people once arrived carrying concealed unbelief, whereas truth now arrives and the Lord is asked to effect genuine entry.
Verses 5:65, 5:69, and 5:85 make the hope an enacted conditional pattern, moving from promised admission through fitting response to returned recompense.
The 5:71 and 5:83 contrast recasts belief as reopened reception: blindness and deafness give way to hearing, recognition, affective overflow, and settled assent.
The alliance and registration sequences make being with the صالح people a transfer of affiliation and publicly recognized identity, not bare co-location.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's densest activation was directional: who or what comes, what enters with whom, and who authorizes belonging. Immediate context also linked cognition, affect, witness, social proximity, and admission while allowing those mechanisms to remain distinct.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains open whether admission chiefly names the gardens confirmed in 5:85, present communal incorporation, or both.
The register-to-admission sequence may be a deliberate two-stage transition or two adjacent descriptions of one acceptance.
صالحين and محسنين are functionally connected by the reward sequence but are not lexically identical classes.
The jointed-body and hydraulic readings are branch-led analogies and should remain secondary.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hope directs recognition toward communal entry.** `ط م ع B001` is heartfelt hope, `د خ ل B005` an entrant mixed into a group, and `ص ل ح B002` reconciliation. Truth's arrival generates desire not for private possession but incorporation among a repaired people. I infer that belief seeks a social body in which recognition can operate.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hope pulls recognition toward communal entry.** Fixed **ط م ع / B001** (“heartfelt desire and hope”) supplies the forward attraction, and fixed **د خ ل / B001** supplies its desired boundary crossing. 5:83 moves from recognized truth to witness; 5:85 realizes entry into gardens, while 5:86 contrasts companionship with blaze. I infer that hope converts assent into a request for placement among a sound people. The ayah reads belief as movement toward a moral company, not only acceptance of incoming information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:85 realized the hoped-for entry, while 5:86’s opposing companionship showed that response to truth sorts agents into durable companies.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وجوب الشيء ولزومه، وكون المرء حقيقا أو محقوقا به، والإيجاب والاستيجاب والاستحقاق.
يدخل فيه الحق والحقوق والحقة بمعنى الحق الخاص، والأحقية بين أصحاب المطالبة، والاستحقاق بمعنى ملك الحق على غيره.

branches.branch_image_ar: محاقة يدعي كل طرف فيها الحق
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حاقه وحاققته وتحاق القوم واحتقوا، أي تخاصموا وادعى كل واحد أن الحق معه، ومنه نزق الحقاق.
يدخل فيه أحققت وحققت بمعنى أثبت الحق أو حكمت بكونه حقا أو صدقت القول، وإحقاق الحق بإظهار الأدلة أو إكمال الأمر.
يدخل فيه الحاقة اسما للقيامة أو الساعة لأنها تحق الأمور أو تحق كل إنسان بعمله أو يحق فيها الجزاء.
يدخل فيه حقيقة الرجل وما يحق عليه أن يحميه أو يلزمه الدفاع عنه، ومعه الراية والحرمة والفناء حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الحق والحقة من الإبل إذا استكمل الثالثة ودخل في الرابعة واستحق الحمل أو الركوب، وحق اللقاح ووقت الضرب، وسمن الناقة أو المال عند تمام الربيع حيث نصت المصادر.
يدخل فيه الطعنة المحتقة والطعن النافذ إلى الجوف أو الذي لا زيغ فيه، وما يقابله المشرم الذي يجرح ولا ينفذ.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun olduğunu bildiren kalıba bağlıdır; bu kullanım yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yapıda, bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun düşmesi, ona uyması ve onun alanından sayılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey ile yöneldiği kişi arasında uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı ifade, belirli bir şeyin muhataba uygun olduğunu onun alanından veya türünden sayılma açıklamasıyla verir; anlam bütünüyle bu kişi yönelimli yapıya bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uyduğunu bildiren kaynak yapısının kişi yönelimli uygunluk ilişkisini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Şey ile kişi arasındaki uygunluk ilişkisini ve yapının kişi yönelimli sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne, seçenek veya işin muhatabın alanına, durumuna ya da niteliğine uygun olduğu söylenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun düşmesini doğal bir cümle içinde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şey veya iş ile kişi arasındaki uygunluk ilişkisinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin veya durumun bir kişiye uygun düşmesini ve kişiye yakışmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Olumlu ya da olumsuz tanıklık farkı anlam sınırı kurmaz; iki dal kişiye uygunluk çekirdeğinde aynı kapsamı paylaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki şeyin birbirine uyması ve tarafların düşünce veya işte aynı yönde birleşmesi komşu dalın daha geniş alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal öğeler arasında bağdaşma, uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal şeyden kişiye yönelen uygunluğu anlatır; komşu dal karşılıklı uyumu ve insanlar arasındaki anlaşmayı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Uygun olmak, kişi ile şey arasındaki bağdaşmayı bildirir; yeterli olmak ise miktar, işlev veya ihtiyacı karşılama ölçütüne dayanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uyması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişi, iş veya şeyin kendi başına iyi ve düzgün olması ya da düzeltilmesi komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kişiye uygunluk ve kendi başına düzgünlük
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şey hakkında olumlu bir değerlendirme bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkisel ve kalıba bağlıdır; komşu dal ise şeyin içsel durumunu veya bu durumun iyileştirilmesini anlatır.
